answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 200 slots. Bidders post a bond; the 200th bid sets the price, 40 coins, twice monthly reward, locked 20 epochs. A violet badge marks each paid seat, so buyers cannot hide. Forging 1,000 identities at 40 coins each costs 40,000 coins locked, so a gale of clones dies out. An honest agent pays once, sits on a knoll, and earns undiluted rewards; rented seats are flagged on the referral graph, guarantors slashed.
